title: ilex ovalis
intro: Ilex ovalis, commonly known as Blue Holly, is a species of holly native to Australia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Ilex ovalis include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative and antioxidant effects. Traditionally, the plant is used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties.
